title: FF1600 Rookie Series Fixed Oulton Park Intl Track Guide 2026 S3

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake before the black banner on the left, peak at 60%.
corners.exit: Get back to power before you strike the curb.

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brake at the beginning of the inverted hump, 55% pressure.
corners.exit: Get back to full throttle once you feel the car squat down.

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Use a small amount brake pressure to accomplish faster rotation.
corners.mistakes: Don't lift off the throttle, use brake pressure to gain traction.

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Brake at the dirt patch on the left, use threshold braking.
corners.exit: Back to full throttle once the front tires grip.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Brake before the marshal stand, 60% pressure.

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake at the 100 meter board, 70% pressure.
corners.line: Use as much curb as possible for both corners.

corners.label: T12
corners.line: Hit the inside curb, but don't be greedy.
corners.exit: Keep the car to the left to shorten track distance.
corners.mistakes: Don't run too wide on exit to the point that you bottom out.

corners.braking: Brake at the green and white stripes after the tire barrier, downshift into third.
corners.line: Get as close as possible to the curbs to make a double apex.
corners.mistakes: Another exit that can catch you well if you run too wide.

corners.exit: Back the power as soon as your car is alongside the curb.

general_tips: Nibble the apex curb, but don't be greedy.
